003import java.util.ArrayList;

018import org.clafer.ir.IrBoolExpr;
019import org.clafer.ir.IrCompare;

022import org.clafer.ir.IrIntVar;
023import org.clafer.ir.IrModule;

026import static org.clafer.ir.Irs.equal;
027import static org.clafer.ir.Irs.greaterThanEqual;
028import static org.clafer.ir.Irs.lessThanEqual;
029import static org.clafer.ir.Irs.mul;
030import org.clafer.math.LinearEquation;
031import org.clafer.math.LinearEquation.Op;
032import org.clafer.math.LinearFunction;

038/**
039 *
040 * @author jimmy
041 */
042public class LinearEquationOptimizer {
043
044    private boolean lossy = false;
045
046    private LinearEquationOptimizer() {
047    }
048
049    private LinearFunction linearFunction(IrIntExpr expr, Map<IrIntVar, Variable> map) {
050        LinearFunctionBuilder builder = new LinearFunctionBuilder();
051        return linearFunction(expr, builder, map) ? builder.toFunction() : null;
052    }
053
054    private boolean linearFunction(IrIntExpr expr, LinearFunctionBuilder builder, Map<IrIntVar, Variable> map) {
055        if (expr instanceof IrIntVar) {
056            Domain domain = expr.getDomain();
057            if (domain.isConstant()) {
058                builder.plusConstant(domain.getLowBound());
059            } else {
060                IrIntVar var = (IrIntVar) expr;
061                Variable variable = map.get(var);
062                if (variable == null) {
063                    variable = new Variable(var.getName(), var.getLowBound(), var.getHighBound());
064                    map.put(var, variable);
065                }
066                builder.plusTerm(variable);
067            }
068            return true;
069        } else if (expr instanceof IrAdd) {
070            IrAdd add = (IrAdd) expr;
071            for (IrIntExpr addend : add.getAddends()) {
072                if (!linearFunction(addend, builder, map)) {
073                    return false;
074                }
075            }
076            builder.plusConstant(add.getOffset());
077            return true;
078        } else if (expr instanceof IrMul) {
079            IrMul mul = (IrMul) expr;
080            int coefficient;
081            IrIntExpr variable;
082            if (mul.getMultiplicand().isConstant()) {
083                coefficient = mul.getMultiplicand().getLowBound();
084                variable = mul.getMultiplier();
085            } else if (mul.getMultiplier().isConstant()) {
086                coefficient = mul.getMultiplier().getLowBound();
087                variable = mul.getMultiplicand();
088            } else {
089                return false;
090            }
091            LinearFunctionBuilder mulBuilder = new LinearFunctionBuilder();
092            if (linearFunction(variable, mulBuilder, map)) {
093                builder.plusFunction(mulBuilder.toFunction().mul(coefficient));
094                return true;
095            }
096        }
097        return false;
098    }
099
100    private Triple<LinearEquation, Domain, Domain> linearEquation(IrIntExpr expr, Map<IrIntVar, Variable> map) {
101        if (expr instanceof IrCompare) {
102            IrCompare compare = (IrCompare) expr;
103
104            if (!NotEqual.equals(compare.getOp())) {
105                LinearFunction left = linearFunction(compare.getLeft(), map);
106                if (left != null) {
107                    LinearFunction right = linearFunction(compare.getRight(), map);
108                    if (right != null) {
109                        switch (compare.getOp()) {
110                            case Equal:
111                                return new Triple<>(LinearEquation.equal(left, right),
112                                        compare.getLeft().getDomain(), compare.getRight().getDomain());
113                            case LessThanEqual:
114                                return new Triple<>(LinearEquation.lessThanEqual(left, right),
115                                        compare.getLeft().getDomain(), compare.getRight().getDomain());
116                        }
117                    }
118                }
119            }
120        }
121        return null;
122    }
123
124    private Optional<LinearEquation> round(LinearEquation equation) {
125        LinearFunction left = equation.getLeft();
126        Rational[] cs = left.getCoefficients();
127        Op op = equation.getOp();
128        Rational right = equation.getRight();
129        Rational min = right;
130        Rational max = right;
131        long lcm = cs[0].getDenominator();
132        if (Op.Equal.equals(op)) {
133            lcm = Util.lcm(lcm, right.getDenominator());
134        }
135        min = min.min(cs[0]);
136        max = max.max(cs[0]);
137        for (int i = 1; i < cs.length; i++) {
138            Rational c = cs[i];
139            min = min.min(c);
140            max = max.max(c);
141            lcm = Util.lcm(lcm, c.getDenominator());
142        }
143        Rational multiplier;
144        if (Op.LessThanEqual.equals(op)) {
145            long gcd = cs[0].mul(lcm).getNumerator();
146            for (int i = 1; i < cs.length; i++) {
147                Rational c = cs[i];
148                gcd = Util.gcd(gcd, c.mul(lcm).getNumerator());
149            }
150            gcd = Math.abs(gcd);
151            multiplier = new Rational(lcm, gcd);
152        } else {
153            multiplier = new Rational(lcm);
154        }
155        if (max.mul(multiplier).ceil() < 50000 && min.mul(multiplier).floor() > -50000) {
156            return Optional.of(
157                    new LinearEquation(equation.getLeft().mul(multiplier),
158                            equation.getOp(),
159                            Op.Equal.equals(op)
160                                    ? equation.getRight().mul(multiplier)
161                                    : new Rational(equation.getRight().mul(multiplier).floor()),
162                            false)
163            );
164        }
165        lossy = true;
166        return Optional.empty();
167    }
168
169    private static IrIntExpr scale(int c, IrIntExpr var) {
170        int a = c * var.getLowBound();
171        int b = c * var.getHighBound();
172        return mul(c, var, Domains.boundDomain(Math.min(a, b), Math.max(a, b)));
173    }
174
175    private Optional<IrBoolExpr> boolExpr(LinearEquation equation, Map<Variable, IrIntVar> map, int low, int high) {
176        Optional<LinearEquation> roundOpt = round(equation);
177        if (!roundOpt.isPresent()) {
178            return Optional.empty();
179        }
180        LinearEquation round = roundOpt.get();
181        LinearFunction left = round.getLeft();
182        Rational[] cs = left.getCoefficients();
183        Variable[] vs = left.getVariables();
184        Rational right = round.getRight();
185
186        if (right.isZero() && cs.length == 2) {
187            int c0 = (int) cs[0].getNumerator();
188            IrIntVar v0 = map.get(vs[0]);
189            int c1 = (int) cs[1].getNumerator();
190            IrIntVar v1 = map.get(vs[1]);
191            switch (round.getOp()) {
192                case Equal:
193                    if (c0 < 0) {
194                        return Optional.of(equal(scale(-c0, v0), scale(c1, v1)));
195                    }
196                    return Optional.of(equal(scale(c0, v0), scale(-c1, v1)));
197                case LessThanEqual:
198                    if (c0 < 0) {
199                        return Optional.of(greaterThanEqual(scale(-c0, v0), scale(c1, v1)));
200                    }
201                    return Optional.of(lessThanEqual(scale(c0, v0), scale(-c1, v1)));
202                default:
203                    throw new IllegalStateException();
204            }
205        }
206
207        IrIntExpr[] addends = new IrIntExpr[cs.length];
208        boolean neg = Stream.of(cs).filter(Rational::isNegative).count() * 2 > addends.length;
209        for (int j = 0; j < addends.length; j++) {
210            assert cs[j].isWhole();
211            long coefficient = cs[j].getNumerator();
212            int coefficientI = (int) (neg ? -coefficient : coefficient);
213            IrIntVar var = map.get(vs[j]);
214
215            addends[j] = scale(coefficientI, var);
216        }
217        assert right.isWhole();
218        switch (round.getOp()) {
219            case Equal:
220                return Optional.of(equal(add(addends), (int) (neg ? -right.getNumerator() : right.getNumerator())));
221            case LessThanEqual:
222                if (neg) {
223                    return Optional.of(greaterThanEqual(add(addends), (int) -right.getNumerator()));
224                } else {
225                    return Optional.of(lessThanEqual(add(addends), (int) right.getNumerator()));
226                }
227            default:
228                throw new IllegalStateException();
229        }
230    }
231
232    private IrModule optimizeImpl(IrModule module) {
233        List<IrBoolExpr> constraints = new ArrayList<>();
234        Set<LinearEquation> equations = new HashSet<>();
235        Map<IrIntVar, Variable> map = new HashMap<>();
236        int low = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
237        int high = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
238        Map<LinearEquation, IrBoolExpr> trace = new HashMap<>();
239        for (IrBoolExpr constraint : module.getConstraints()) {
240            Triple<LinearEquation, Domain, Domain> pair = linearEquation(constraint, map);
241            if (pair != null) {
242                LinearEquation equation = pair.getFst();
243                Domain d1 = pair.getSnd();
244                Domain d2 = pair.getThd();
245                equations.add(equation);
246                low = Math.min(Math.min(low, d1.getLowBound()), d2.getLowBound());
247                high = Math.max(Math.max(high, d1.getHighBound()), d2.getHighBound());
248                trace.put(equation, constraint);
249            } else {
250                constraints.add(constraint);
251            }
252        }
253        if (equations.size() > 0) {
254            Map<Variable, IrIntVar> inverse = Util.inverse(map);
255
256            DisjointSets<Either<LinearEquation, Variable>> ds = new DisjointSets<>();
257            for (LinearEquation equation : equations) {
258                Either<LinearEquation, Variable> left = Either.left(equation);
259                for (Variable variable : equation.getVariables()) {
260                    Either<LinearEquation, Variable> right = Either.right(variable);
261                    ds.union(left, right);
262                }
263            }
264            for (Set<Either<LinearEquation, Variable>> component : ds.connectedComponents()) {
265                Set<LinearEquation> componentEquations = Either.filterLeft(component);
266                LinearSystem system = new LinearSystem(componentEquations);
267                for (LinearEquation equation : system
268                        .equalityElimination()
269                        .fourierMotzkinElimination()
270                        .strengthenInequalities()
271                        .gaussJordanElimination()
272                        // TODO only add back necessary equations
273                        .addEquations(componentEquations)
274                        .dominantElimination()
275                        .getEquations()) {
276                    boolExpr(equation, inverse, low, high).ifPresent(constraints::add);
277                }
278
279                if (lossy) {
280                    for (LinearEquation componentEquation : componentEquations) {
281                        constraints.add(trace.get(componentEquation));
282                    }
283                }
284            }
285            return new IrModule().addConstraints(constraints);
286        }
287        return module;
288    }
289
290    public static IrModule optimize(IrModule module) {
291        try {
292            return new LinearEquationOptimizer().optimizeImpl(module);
293        } catch (ArithmeticException e) {
294            // The equations are too large for exact arithmetic over longs. The
295            // optimization only tightens bounds, so skip it.
296            return module;
297        }
298    }
299}
